elements.text: Chandrayaan-3 terrain reconstruction  |  Evidence snapshot: 9 Nov 2026

Workstream	Concrete deliverable	Acceptance evidence
Colleague / GPU work	Learned outputs ZIP; >10-method trials	Pinned model/config, repeats, hashes, failures
Evaluator implementation	Parallax + temporal-gap gates	Frozen/crossfade failures; positive control retained
Independent review	Common-split results and comparison	Coverage + reprojection + fixed-region error
Simulation / navigation	Actual OBJ imported into Blender	Camera comparison; per-cause rejection counts
Image priors	Reviewed rock/crater proposals	Semantic checks + reliable depth association
